title: Dividing by playing time removes part of the association it should scale: measuring the denominator gradient in eight European leagues
description: Replication record for a study of the denominator gradient: the slope of log recorded match minutes on recent match exposure, which measures how much of an exposure association a per-minute denominator divides out. The record contains the manuscript and supplement, the full analysis pipeline, its test suite at complete statement and branch coverage, the hand-built audit evidence no script can regenerate, and the documentation needed to rerun every reported number from the committed inputs.
